Messages.Author: Raven
Messages.Body:
Hello,

If Eye of Hazimel is burned via yelding a contest, does it deals damage to vampire by it's cardtext?

Equipment
Eye of Hazimel

Unique.
The bearer gets +1 bleed and +1 strength. The bearer can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action. This vampire gets superior Potence and superior Chimerstry, and combat cards cost this vampire 1 fewer blood. While the bearer is ready, this equipment cannot be moved or stolen. If this equipment is burned, it inflicts 5 unpreventable environmental damage on the bearer. During your unlock phase, burn 1 pool or burn this equipment.

Messages.Author: acbishop
Messages.Body: For the duration of the contest, all of the contested cards are turned face down and are out of play. When you yield the contest they move from out of play to the ashheap, so Eye of Hazimel cardtext (5 unpreventable damage) doesn't apply

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> acbishop wrote:
> For the duration of the contest, all of the contested cards are turned face down and are out of play. When you yield the contest they move from out of play to the ashheap, so Eye of Hazimel cardtext (5 unpreventable damage) doesn't apply
>
Correct. A contested card is never "briefly" in play.
